title: Complete the Lithuanian catalogue and keep it complete
task:
`src/messages/lt.json` is missing `badge.updated`, so a Lithuanian reader sees an English sentence.

1. Add the missing Lithuanian message, keeping the `{when}` placeholder intact.
2. Add `test/locale-completeness.test.mjs` that reads every catalogue in `src/messages` and asserts that each one carries exactly the same key set as the default locale, and that every placeholder in a translation also appears in the default text. The test must be data-driven — adding a third locale file must extend its coverage without editing the test.

Do not change `src/i18n.mjs` or the rendering code: this task is about the catalogues and the check that guards them.
